payload.goal: Add express/standard order priority and backorder recording across the existing domain, application and API. An order that exceeds available stock must remain cancellable, record a positive backorder, emit one application event, and be observable through the API. Preserve existing behavior. Add focused tests beside the modified code.

diagnostics.message: Repository contains no structurally indexed TypeScript or JavaScript source files.

node.title: Order Priority & Backorder Feature
node.objective: Add express/standard order priority and backorder recording across domain, application, and API layers so that orders exceeding available stock remain cancellable, record a positive backorder quantity, emit exactly one application event, and are observable through the API, while preserving existing behavior.

node.title: Domain: order priority & backorder invariants
node.objective: Introduce an OrderPriority concept (express/standard) and backorder-quantity recording on the order domain model, preserving the existing cancellation invariant when stock is insufficient.

node.title: Application: backorder computation & event emission
node.objective: Orchestrate order placement so that insufficient-stock orders compute and persist a positive backorder quantity, remain cancellable, and emit exactly one application event, without altering existing order-placement behavior for in-stock orders.

node.title: API: priority input & backorder observability
node.objective: Accept order priority on order-creation requests and expose backorder status/quantity on order read endpoints, preserving existing request/response contracts for unaffected fields.

node.objective: Give the order domain model an express/standard priority and a positive backorder quantity recorded when requested quantity exceeds available stock, without weakening the existing cancellation invariant.

node.title: Application: order placement orchestration and backorder event
